description: This file defines the implementation of a configuration class for background synchronization in a system. It includes parsing logic from a Config object, getters for configuration parameters, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

classes.name: DefaultBackgroundSyncConfig
classes.description: A package-private final class implementing BackgroundSyncConfig, encapsulating configuration parameters for background sync operations.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultBackgroundSyncConfig instance from a Config object.

methods.name: fromUpdaterConfig
methods.description: Creates a DefaultBackgroundSyncConfig instance using a fallback mechanism for configuration.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether background sync is enabled.

methods.name: getQuietPeriod
methods.description: Returns the duration of the quiet period between syncs.

methods.name: getKeptEvents
methods.description: Returns the number of events to keep.

methods.name: getToleranceWindow
methods.description: Returns the tolerance window duration for index staleness.

methods.name: getThrottleThroughput
methods.description: Returns the number of items to process per throttle period.

methods.name: getThrottlePeriod
methods.description: Returns the duration of the throttle period.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum idle time before failing the stream.

methods.name: getPolicyAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for policy shard region requests.

methods.name: getMinBackoff
methods.description: Returns the minimum backoff duration for retries.

methods.name: getMaxBackoff
methods.description: Returns the maximum backoff duration for retries.

methods.name: getMaxRestarts
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of restart attempts.
